User: best format for photos?
Assistant: It depends on the purpose. For sharing, JPEG is the usual choice; for editing or archiving, a lossless format such as TIFF or PNG keeps full quality. What will you use the photos for?
User: archiving I guess
Assistant: For archiving, TIFF (optionally with lossless LZW compression) is the most widely supported choice; PNG is also lossless and smaller. Keep at least two copies on different media.
